description: Keep EXACT same back-facing NORTH knight, same camera, size, armor, crown, cloth, planted boots and original positions on 256x256 transparent canvas. Change ONLY arms and sword into the anticipation apex of a two-handed overhead SLAM. Both hands together directly ABOVE the center of the helmet, elbows raised symmetrically to both sides. ONE same straight greatsword points almost vertically UP toward top-center of canvas, clearly above helmet. We see the BACK of his helmet and shoulders and tabard exactly as original, no face or chest. Feet remain at same x/y. An upright blade centered over the head, NOT a horizontal sword on shoulder, NOT a sideways swing. Dark charcoal metal and restrained rusty orange edge of original sword. No effect, no background, no glow halo, no extra weapons.
